get.description: Get intraday price matching history for a stock symbol.
Get intraday OHLCV bars (minute/hour) for a ticker.

parameters.description: Ticker to query (stock, covered warrant, index, derivative). Max 10 characters. E.g. GEL.
parameters.name: ticker

parameters.description: Ticker type: stock, coveredWarr (covered warrant), index, derivative.
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: End time (epoch timestamp in seconds). Latest point of data to return.
parameters.name: to

low.description: L (Low) — lowest price in the timeframe.
